title: The Magic Key
purpose: Explore JSON/typed constraints as non-authoritative IR for exact JANUS proof-state identity, future-equivalence compression, representation-language selection and replayable provenance.
new_findings: Magic Key is split into MK_ID for exact-state identity and MK_FUTURE for certified future-semantic equivalence.
Minimality is not part of the theorem core; polynomial size/discovery/verification/update/sufficiency are the relevant obligations.
Primary R0: 4,644 reachable CNF states, 55,728 ASSIGN/EXISTS congruence checks, 0 ROBDD semantic collisions and 13,195 safe merge pairs; verdict FINITE_SURVIVOR_NOT_THEOREM.

Independent narrower R0 reproducibility epoch: 482 states, 4,702 replayed structural semantic collisions, 0 ROBDD collisions, 130 safe merge pairs and 5,784/5,784 congruence checks; do not double-count as theorem evidence.
R1 separates semantic correctness from representation complexity: EQ_m grouped numeric order has exact node signature 3*2^m-3 while interleaved pair order has 3m nodes.
R1 m=13 reproduces the historical C022 signature 24,573 grouped vs 39 interleaved nodes; this is a rediscovered recurring barrier, not independent novelty.
A symbolic residual-future argument gives a >=2^m grouped-order OBDD cut lower bound on EQ_m, refuting fixed grouped/numeric-order ROBDD as a universal polynomial MK_FUTURE representation.
R2A exactly enumerated every OBDD order for HWB through n=8; n=8 best/median/worst sizes were 46/59/66 with 40,320 orders checked and zero semantic failures.
External literature independently places HWB in the all-order exponential OBDD-hard class; this remains an external theorem reference, not an internally re-proved JANUS theorem receipt.

R2B built an exact HWB SDD-style partition certificate through n=12 with zero partition or semantic failures, but the concrete certificate did not beat the best OBDD on overlapping finite n<=8; frozen G4 therefore FAILed.
New law: representation-language class advantage does not imply a concrete compiler is cost-competitive.
Projected-semantics guard is now explicit: auxiliary/Tseitin state cannot hide interface complexity; measure EXISTS z F(x,z) on frozen interface x and charge auxiliary state separately.
Total certified representation cost now includes payload plus detection, language/structure choice, compile, update, translate and verify; unmeasured components remain OPEN, never zero.
algorithmic_spine: SEARCH_GRAMMAR + REPRESENTATION_GRAMMAR + INTERFACE_GRAMMAR + PROCESS_LINEAGE + MK_ID/MK_FUTURE quotient semantics + BCEG exact composition + charged representation portfolio
truth_firewall: Equal MK_FUTURE means certified merge only after future-equivalence certification
Representation blow-up is not semantic collision
Family-specific good order is not universal polynomial order discovery
External asymptotic succinctness theorem does not make an unmeasured JANUS compiler free
Auxiliary state is not free semantic compression
Missing detection/translation/switching cost is OPEN, not zero
next_gate: MK_BCEG_R2C_DISCOVERY_ATTACK: remove oracle family labels; provide only a frozen opaque typed/CNF state, require JANUS to pay detection, representation-language and structure-selection costs, compare JANUS-discovered package against oracle-best for evaluation only, and preserve projected-semantics and exact-replay firewalls. R2D cross-language congruence and R2E cumulative switching monster remain subsequent frozen gates.
